calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.needApp: Set a calendar application in Settings → Applications.
calendar.connectedHint: Events appear in the Date and time panel and refresh automatically.
calendar.protonStep1: Open Proton Calendar settings with the button below and choose your calendar.
calendar.protonStep2: Under “Share outside Proton”, create a link with full view and copy it.
calendar.protonStep3: Paste the link here and select Connect.
calendar.googleStep1: Open Google Calendar settings with the button below.
calendar.googleStep2: On the left, pick your calendar under “Settings for my calendars”, then scroll to “Integrate calendar”.
calendar.googleStep3: Copy the “Secret address in iCal format”, paste it here and select Connect.
calendar.googleWorkNote: Work or school accounts: if the secret address is missing, your administrator has turned it off.
calendar.appleStep1: Open your Apple Account with the button below and sign in.
calendar.appleStep2: Under “Sign-In and Security”, choose “App-Specific Passwords” and create one named “ModernOS”. Two-factor authentication must be on.
calendar.appleStep3: Enter your Apple ID and the new password here, then select Connect.
calendar.appleLinkStep1: On iCloud.com, open Calendar and select the share icon next to a calendar.
calendar.appleLinkStep2: Turn on “Public Calendar” and copy the link.
calendar.appleLinkStep3: Paste the link here and select Connect. Only this one calendar is shown.
calendar.appleUseLink: Use a shared calendar link instead
calendar.appleIdFormat: Enter the email address of your Apple ID.
calendar.applePasswordFormat: An app-specific password has 16 letters, like abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop. Your normal Apple ID password does not work here.
calendar.linkNotUrl: That is not a link. It should start with https:// or webcal://.
calendar.linkGoogleWrong: This is a Google Calendar page, not the calendar link. Copy the “Secret address in iCal format” instead.
calendar.linkProtonWrong: This is a Proton page, not the calendar link. Copy the share link from the calendar's settings.
calendar.linkAppleWrong: This is an iCloud page, not a calendar link. Copy the link shown under “Public Calendar”.
calendar.errorAppleAuth: Apple did not accept this Apple ID and app-specific password. Check the email address or create a new app-specific password.
calendar.errorLinkAuth: The calendar refused this link. It may have been reset; copy a new one.
calendar.errorLink: This link does not lead to a calendar. Copy the iCal link again.
calendar.errorOffline: The calendar server could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
calendar.errorGeneric: The calendar could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

ai.systemBrief: Reply in the user's language. Keep the friendly card style: emoji in short headings, a numbered list for steps, a blank line between sections. Stay short: a few list items only, no essay and no preamble. If a fact may have changed or you are unsure, call web_search before you answer.
ai.systemRoom: Reply in the user's language. Keep the friendly card style: emoji in short headings, a numbered list for steps, a blank line between sections. If a fact may have changed or you are unsure, call web_search before you answer.

use.chat: Best for everyday chat, writing, and short answers.
use.code: Best for writing, explaining, and fixing code.
use.vision: Best when a question includes a picture.
use.reason: Best for hard questions that need a careful chain of thought.
use.embed: Best for search. It compares text and does not hold a conversation.
use.ocr: Best for reading text out of a picture or a scan.
use.open: Best for open-ended chat with fewer refusals.
use.alsoThink: It can think a question through before it answers.

use.alsoVision: It can also look at a picture.

hints.animations: How long menus, the bar, and windows take to move. Off is instant.
hints.overlayMotion: Fade in/out, zoom in on open / zoom out on close, or both.
hints.wallpaperProvider: The site opened from the wallpaper picker to fetch new pictures. Downloads from that site are added to your wallpapers.
hints.wallpaperColor: Lightens surfaces, buttons, and icons with the wallpaper color. Higher is brighter.
hints.wallpaperTransition: How the desktop switches to a new wallpaper. The choice plays that animation once on the picture showing now.
hints.activeProfile: Each card is a different palette matugen pulled from the current wallpaper.
hints.themeVariant: How strongly wallpaper hues show. Each card is generated from the current wallpaper in the light or dark mode you picked.
hints.workspaceMode: Dynamic opens a workspace on the display under the cursor; each bar shows only that display’s workspaces. Fixed keeps 1–5, 6–10, 11–15, … from left to right.
hints.primaryMonitor: New windows and games open on this display. When unset, the first connected display is used.
hints.hdr: Wide-gamut HDR panels (QD-OLED) need this on. Hyprland only maps sRGB saturation in HDR; 10-bit PQ output.
hints.storageGated: Snapshots are applied by the gated install/system helpers.
hints.timeMerged: Date and time formats live under Language & Time.
hints.weatherLocation: When on, weather uses this location. When off, choose a city.
hints.frecency: Sorts apps by how often and how recently they were launched.
hints.ollamaModel: Pulled locally with ollama pull. Used by the bar assistant.
hints.aiThinking: The model thinks the question through before it answers. Replies take longer.
hints.aiBrief: Keeps answers to a few lines. Off allows a longer reply.
hints.braveKey: Paste a Brave Search key. The assistant uses it when an answer needs the web.
hints.aiLibrary: Search the library, then install a model or delete one you no longer use.
hints.geminiAccount: Paste an API key from Google AI Studio. Replies use the API quota on that account.
hints.geminiModel: Used by the bar assistant when Gemini is selected.
hints.chatgptAccount: Paste an API key from the OpenAI platform. Replies use API credits on that account.
hints.chatgptModel: Used by the bar assistant when ChatGPT is selected.
hints.audioDevices: The highlighted device is the default. Click another to send sound there.
hints.windowRulesJson: JSON array of Hyprland window rules. Save validates before writing.
hints.gameFullscreen: Forces exclusive fullscreen as soon as the game window appears, instead of waiting for the engine to request it.
hints.gameOptimize: Turns off extra window effects on the game so it can run smoother. Other windows keep their usual look.
hints.gameHdr: Games can use HDR, and the rest of the screen stays as it is. Turn HDR on under Displays first. Battle.net games pick it up the next time they start. A Steam game needs it in that game's own launch options.
hints.browserLight: Vivaldi starts without a separate graphics process, and its windows skip blur and shadows. Turn this on when the browser takes several seconds to open on a slow processor. It applies the next time Vivaldi starts.
hints.gameMode: Keeps the session awake while a game is open and marks that window as a game.
hints.easePc: Turns off blur and shadows on games and the browser so they can run faster. Other windows keep those effects. Restart the browser once so it picks this up.
hints.repeatRate: How many times a second a held key types again, once the delay has passed. A higher number types faster.
hints.repeatDelay: Wait before a held key starts repeating.
hints.numlockOnBoot: Turns Num Lock on when the system starts.
hints.autoSwitchBluetooth: When headphones or a speaker connect over Bluetooth, sound switches to them. When they disconnect, it returns to the previous speaker.
hints.restoreGated: Restores the system disk to this snapshot. Your home folder stays. A restart is required.
hints.preUpdateSnapshot: Creates a Snapper snapshot of / before a system update so you can roll back.
hints.backupPrune: When more than {n} snapshots exist, the oldest are deleted.
hints.snapperReady: Point-in-time copies of the system disk (btrfs).
hints.snapperMissing: Snapper is not installed. Setup is gated and is not applied from Settings.
hints.snapperUnconfigured: Snapper needs a root config before it can take snapshots. Create config asks for an admin password and writes that config.
hints.speedTest: Downloads from the Arch geo mirror over several connections for about 15 seconds. Not a third-party speed-test site.
hints.bluetooth: Turns the adapter on. A short search runs, then stops so a connection is not interrupted.
hints.bluetoothBlocked: No Bluetooth adapter, or the radio is hardware-blocked.
hints.wifi: Turns the wireless radio on. Nearby networks appear below.
hints.wifiHardware: No Wi-Fi adapter, or the radio is hardware-blocked.
hints.autologin: After the next restart this account opens the desktop without a login prompt. Turning it off asks for a password again at boot.
hints.firewallActive: Incoming connections are denied except the allow rules below. Outgoing traffic is allowed.
hints.firewallInactive: UFW is installed but not filtering. Turning it on sets deny incoming, allow outgoing, deny routed.
hints.firewallMissing: UFW is not installed. The firewall package is in the base manifest and is not applied from Settings.

backup.restoreBody: The system goes back to snapshot {n} from {date}. Files in your home folder stay. The computer restarts when the restore finishes.

firewall.enableBody: Incoming traffic is denied except the allow rules. Outgoing is allowed. Forwarded traffic is denied. Rules stay in UFW across reboot.
firewall.disableBody: This stops filtering until you enable it again. Existing rules are kept.
firewall.addBody: Port is required. From empty means anywhere. Hostnames are not allowed.
firewall.stale: That rule is no longer in the list. Refresh and try again.

bugReport.title: Report a problem
bugReport.summaryHelpBody: One sentence that names the problem. For example: Sound stops after waking up.
bugReport.stepsHelpBody:
Write the steps so the same thing can be made to happen again on this computer.

Start from what you were doing.
Put one action on each line, in the order you did them.
Say what you expected, then what happened instead.
Say if it happens every time, only sometimes, or only once.
